classes.name: Dedication
classes.description: Those who follow the path of Dedication are warriors forged through unrelenting discipline and singular focus. Whether driven by duty, honour, or an inner fire that refuses to dim, they have honed their bodies and minds into instruments of martial perfection. It is this relentless pursuit of mastery over their craft that draws them to the life of an adventurer.
classes.flavor: The warrior archetype - discipline, martial mastery, and physical perfection

1.name: Fighting Style
1.description: Choose a fighting style: Marksmanship (+2 ranged attack rolls), Defense (+1 AC in armor), Dueling (+2 damage with one-handed melee weapon), Great Weapon Fighting (reroll 1s and 2s on two-handed weapon damage), Mariner (traverse deep water, +1 AC if no heavy armor/shield), or Unarmed Fighting (1d6 unarmed strikes, 1d8 if both hands free).

1.name: Steady Nerve
1.description: As a bonus action, choose one of the following options: Heal (regain 1d8 + your Dedication level + CON modifier HP), Attack (make one weapon attack), Dash (double movement this turn), Disengage (movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks), or Dodge (attackers have disadvantage until start of your next turn). Once per short rest.

1.name: Weapon Mastery
1.description: You master 3 weapons of your choice. You can use the mastery property of any weapon you're proficient with and have mastered.

2.name: Action Surge
2.description: Take one additional action on your turn. Once per short rest (twice at 17th level).

3.name: Deflect Missiles
3.description: When hit by a ranged weapon attack, use your reaction to reduce damage by 1d10 + DEX modifier + your level. If you reduce it to 0, you can catch the missile and spend 1 stamina to throw it back (20/60 range).

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Max 20.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.description: Attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action.

5.name: Stunning Strike
5.description: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, spend 1 stamina to force a CON save (DC 8 + proficiency + WIS mod). On failure, target is stunned until the end of your next turn.

classes.name: Scholar
classes.description: Scholars are seekers of knowledge who have turned their intellect into power. Through years of study, experimentation, and arcane research, they have learned to reshape reality itself. Whether driven by academic curiosity, a thirst for forbidden lore, or the desire to push the boundaries of what is possible, their pursuit of understanding leads them into the unknown.
classes.flavor: The mage archetype - intellect, arcane mastery, and innovation

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: You can cast wizard spells using INT as your spellcasting ability. You prepare spells from your spellbook each long rest (INT modifier + level spells prepared).

1.name: Arcane Recovery
1.description: Once per day during a short rest, recover spell slots with combined level ≤ half your level (rounded up). No slot can be 6th level or higher.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Max 20.

classes.name: Wanderlust
classes.description: Those who follow Wanderlust are restless souls who cannot be tamed. Driven by insatiable curiosity, a love of freedom, or simply the thrill of the unknown, they move through the world with quick wits and quicker fingers. Masters of adaptability, they talk their way out of trouble as easily as they sneak past it, and their breadth of talent makes them invaluable companions.
classes.flavor: The rogue archetype - cunning, versatility, and charm

1.name: Expertise
1.description: Choose 2 skills you're proficient in. Double your proficiency bonus for those skills. Choose 2 more at 6th level.

1.name: Sneak Attack
1.description: Once per turn, deal extra 1d6 damage when you hit with advantage or an ally is within 5 feet of target. Must use finesse or ranged weapon.

1.name: Bardic Inspiration
1.description: Grant an ally a d6 inspiration die they can add to an ability check, attack roll, or save within 10 minutes. Uses = CHA modifier per short rest.

2.name: Cunning Action
2.description: Use a bonus action to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

2.name: Jack of All Trades
2.description: Add half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) to any ability check you make that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus.

2.name: Song of Rest
2.description: During a short rest, allies who spend hit dice to heal regain an extra 1d6 HP.

3.name: Fast Hands
3.description: Use Cunning Action bonus action to make a Sleight of Hand check, use thieves' tools to disarm traps/pick locks, or Use an Object.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Max 20.

5.name: Uncanny Dodge
5.description: When an attacker you can see hits you, use your reaction to halve the damage.
